title: If hackers can take control of a supermarket freezer, how vulnerable is other tech?

claims.claim: Supermarkets across Europe have been hit by a suspected cyber-attack affecting their fridges and freezers.

evidence.quote: Supermarkets across Europe have been hit by a suspected cyber-attack affecting their fridges and freezers

claims.claim: In 2015, researchers demonstrated how a vulnerability in a Samsung smart fridge could allow them to intercept internet traffic.

evidence.quote: In 2015, researchers demonstrated how a vulnerability in a Samsung smart fridge could allow them to intercept internet traffic.

claims.claim: Since April 2024, UK law has required manufacturers of certain consumer smart devices to meet minimum cyber security standards.

evidence.quote: Since April 2024, UK law has required manufacturers of certain consumer smart devices to meet minimum cyber security standards
Since April 2024, UK law has required manufacturers of certain consumer smart devices to meet minimum cyber security standards, including requirements around passwords and security updates.

claims.claim: Researchers from UK Cyber Defence have identified more than 800 refrigeration and building-control interfaces associated with British retailers that can be accessed over the public internet.

claims.claim: UK supermarkets M&S and the Co-op were targeted by ransomware hackers in May 2025.

evidence.quote: When UK supermarkets M&S and the Co-op were targeted by ransomware hackers in May 2025
When UK supermarkets M&S and the Co-op were targeted by ransomware hackers in May 2025, the retailers struggled to stock some shop shelves with fresh deliveries.
